note: Cases built from fixtures run through `orb validate --json` (the Rust check): beacon URLs (relative, other scheme, binding, empty, egress and its default ports), beacon requests and options, page-facts lists, on-device calls, tab calls (arity, request keys, non-object requests, options), the emit block of each operator, and the on-device and tab calls of a [background] tick. The collector answer is the HOST_CALLS_COLLECTED the shared collector gives for the same program; the emit-config answer holds the findings Rust reports for each emit object (Rust reports the emit findings of an options object twice, once here and once in its generic browser/* arm: the golden holds them once). The ORB_TAB_REQUEST_INVALID cases compare only the unknown-key and not-an-object messages.
